notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Cast Replication Technique by paying {4}{U}, targeting Invasion of Arcavios.
Replication Technique's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it, with your copy targeting Invasion of Arcavios.
Resolve  your copy of Replication Technique, creating a token copy of Invasion of Arcavios.
When the token Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dramatic Reversal to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the original Replication Technique, creating a token copy of Invasion of Arcavios.
When the token Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Replication Technique to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
If nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {6}{U}{U}, you may earn infinite mana, and then target any other permanent using the copy of Replication Technique.

uses.name: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders
